appDesc.message: Turn YouTube videos into picture books (PDF/PPTX) and scripts (TXT).

popup_notYoutube.message: Open a YouTube video page to run this.

popup_extracting.message: Extracting — progress shows at the top of the video page. The results tab opens when it's done.

popup_connectFail.message: Connection failed — refresh the page and try again.

results_notFound.message: Session not found. Generate it again from YouTube.

downscale_title.message: Shrinks PDF/PPTX/web-page photos to 1280px to reduce file size. Turn off when viewing large, printing, or presenting.

banner_saveFail.message: Failed to save the session. Refresh the page.

banner_recaptureTab.message: High-res capture needs the original YouTube tab open. Showing preview quality for now.

banner_truncated.message: Over 300 scenes — showing strong transitions only. Try lowering sensitivity.

banner_noCaptions.message: This video has no captions, so only scenes are extracted. Script TXT isn't available.

banner_captionFetchFail.message: Captions exist but couldn't be fetched. Try again from the original tab.

overlay_keepTab.message: Keep this tab visible during extraction.

overlay_errorProtected.message: This video is protected and can't be captured.

error_tooLong.message: Videos up to 2 hours are supported.

error_liveUnsupported.message: Live and premiere videos aren't supported.
